summaries.text: This resolution recognizes the contributions of Cambodian veterans of the Khmer National Armed Forces who fought alongside the United States in the early 1970s. The resolution expresses gratitude for their partnership.

title: A resolution recognizing and honoring Cambodian veterans of the Khmer National Armed Forces for their sacrifices, their support of the Armed Forces of the United States, and their defense of freedom in Southeast Asia.
